sections.A: Kandhe ki arthritis mein jor ka cartilage ghis jata hai. Aksar barhi umar ya purani chot ke baad hota hai.
sections.B: Gehra dard jo kaam aur raat ko barhta hai, dheere dheere akdan, external rotation kam, aur kabhi grinding ki aawaz.
sections.C: Dard kitne arse se hai aur dheere dheere barh raha hai ya nahi, aur kya pehle kandha utra tha ya surgery hui.
sections.D: Muscles, sujan, active aur passive range (khaas kar external rotation) aur taaqat dekhein.
sections.E: Kandhe ki arthritis ka koi accurate test nahi. Diagnosis history, passive movement ke nuqsan aur X-ray se hota hai.
sections.F: Frozen shoulder (X-ray normal) aur rotator cuff ka dard (passive range normal) se farq karein.
sections.G: Garam sooja kandha aur bukhar (infection), ya halki chot ke baad achanak shadeed dard (fracture): foran refer.
sections.H: Barhi umar ya purani chot, dheere dheere dard aur passive external rotation kam, X-ray mein jor ki jagah kam: working diagnosis arthritis.
sections.I: Halki mobilisation, kandhe ke gird soft tissue aur thoracic mobilisation thori der ka aaraam deti hain.
sections.J: Pendulum, assisted elevation, stick se external rotation aur dheere dheere taaqat.
sections.K: Garmi aur TENS optional. Dawa ya injection doctor ka faisla hai.
sections.L: Doctor ke zariye imaging, aasaan alfaaz mein samjhana, dard wala load kam karna, phir range aur taaqat. Zaroorat ho to surgery ke baare mein refer.
sections.M: Dard, raat ka dard, external rotation, kaam ki salahiyat aur SPADI ya Oxford score dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 66 saal ke retired builder ko 2 saal se kandhe mein dard aur grinding hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, kaam mein tabdeeli aur dheere dheere exercise.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
